title: Operation File First and the Passport Blitz
summary: On Saturday, January 17, 2015, Jordan independently files his 2014 federal and state tax returns at CPI's VITA clinic to block his mother from claiming him as a dependent, completes his custom seating and joystick fitting for the 350-pound matte-black Vanguard Titan-X350 power wheelchair, and joins all eighteen members of the World Trek roster to submit their U.S. Passport and NEXUS Trusted Traveler applications.
